assumptions.effect: Set to 0, so every time figure here is an UPPER bound on available time and a LOWER bound on required rates.
All data-rate figures are per single bit-plane. Multiply by the bit depth once defined.
No PWM period or minimum on-time is derived.
Progressive one-row-at-a-time scan. Selecting M rows multiplies row current by M and divides per-row time by M; the duty-cycled averages stay the same.
5 um may be the emission area rather than the centre-to-centre pitch, so the physical array size below is conditional.
assumptions.item: Pixel pitch equals the stated 5 um x 5 um

assumptions.effect: No power figure is derived from current alone.
Only the minimum aggregate channel rate is computed.

derived_not_assumed.theoretical_all_pixels_note: What a DC, non-multiplexed panel would draw if every pixel emitted at its 15 uA on-state current at the same time. Listed because the requirement asks for it; it is the arithmetic reason row multiplexing is implied.

excluded_interpretation.statement: Treating 15 uA as a frame AVERAGE and solving for the instantaneous current.
excluded_interpretation.status: EXCLUDED by D1 (student-confirmed 2026-10-04). Kept only so the earlier ambiguity remains traceable.

explicitly_not_computed: device sizing / VDD / process node (needs A7)

basis.data_clock: channels_per_driver / line_time, 1 bit per clock (A2, A8)
basis.frame_average: pixels x I_PIXEL x duty, duty = ROWS_SELECTED/V_ACTIVE (DERIVED from the scan structure, per D1)
